knownIssue: This cloud session's network egress allowlist has blocked essentially every job-board and employer domain (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday, nearly every company apex domain) since ~late July/early August 2026 -- 100+ consecutive daily runs now, all writing 0 verified opportunities for this reason. src/hunt-store.js does not read this field, so the email has looked like an ordinary quiet day for over three months with no way for Dom to distinguish 'no good opportunities today' from 'the hunter cannot reach the internet.' Multiple prior runs (at least 2026-11-11 through 2026-11-13) logged intent to escalate via PushNotification, but life/LOG.md and life/TODO.md -- where a durable fact like this should land per the hub's own rule 4 -- show no trace it was ever recorded or acted on, and this routine is read-only on life/ so it cannot write the escalation there itself. Sent a PushNotification this run making the ask explicit: check this session's/routine's network/egress allowlist configuration so WebFetch can reach job-board domains again.
